import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
edges = np.arange(2.5, 6.75 + 0.25, 0.25)
df['bin_idx'] = pd.cut(df['체류시간 (s)'], bins=edges, right=False, labels=False)
df = df.dropna(subset=['bin_idx'])
df['bin_idx'] = df['bin_idx'].astype(int)
counts = df.groupby(['촉매그룹', 'bin_idx']).size().reset_index(name='n')
valid_bins = counts[counts['n'] >= 10][['촉매그룹', 'bin_idx']]
df = df.merge(valid_bins[['촉매그룹', 'bin_idx']], on=['촉매그룹', 'bin_idx'])
df['midpoint'] = edges[df['bin_idx']] + 0.125

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
for line in ax.get_lines():
    label = line.get_label()
    if label.startswith('_'):
        continue
    x_data = line.get_xdata()
    y_data = line.get_ydata()
    if len(x_data) == 0:
        continue
    max_idx = np.argmax(y_data)
    max_x = x_data[max_idx]
    max_y = y_data[max_idx]
    ax.plot(max_x, max_y, 'o', color=line.get_color(), markersize=8)
    ax.annotate(f'{max_x:.2f}', xy=(max_x, max_y), xytext=(0, 10), textcoords='offset points', ha='center', fontsize=9)
